report.summary: Chunk 2 of 3 of cache.py: encoder/decoder functions for type, field, param, sig, alias, facts; _encode/_decode using zlib+json; _evict_old_caches docstring with claims.
risks: _evict_old_caches | medium | Docstring claims 'Keep only the most recently used cache DBs' but function body is truncated; actual eviction logic not visible. | Review the full function body to confirm it implements LRU eviction.

_dec_facts | low | Converts JSON lists back to tuples; shape-compatible but consumers expecting mutable lists may be surprised. | Check all consumers of PyTypeFacts to ensure they treat tuples as acceptable.
todos: Verify _evict_old_caches implementation matches its docstring claim about recency-based eviction.
Ensure that all consumers of decoded data (e.g., PyTypeFacts fields) handle tuples correctly.

handoff.purpose: Encoder/decoder functions for serialization of analysis data structures, plus beginning of cache eviction function.

symbols.name: _dec_type
symbols.note: Decodes a list to TypeDecl; inverse of _enc_type.

symbols.name: _enc_sig
symbols.note: Encodes SignatureDecl to list, recursively encoding params.

symbols.name: _dec_sig
symbols.note: Decodes list to SignatureDecl, recursively decoding params.

symbols.name: _enc_facts
symbols.note: Encodes PyTypeFacts to list, encoding its subfields.

symbols.name: _dec_facts
symbols.note: Decodes list to PyTypeFacts, decoding subfields.

symbols.name: _encode
symbols.note: Serializes FileAnalysis to compressed JSON bytes using zlib level 1.

symbols.name: _decode
symbols.note: Deserializes bytes to FileAnalysis; uses subscript access to ensure cache miss on missing keys.

symbols.name: _MAX_CACHE_FILES
symbols.note: Constant set to 20, presumably for cache eviction limit.

symbols.name: _evict_old_caches
symbols.note: Docstring claims it keeps only most recently used cache DBs; body truncated.

claims.text: Every field is read by subscript, never .get(<default>): a row written by an older encoder is missing keys, and a default would let it decode into a plausible-looking analysis carrying a wrong measurement (n_tokens=0 reads as 'this file contributes nothing to the repo's token total'). KeyError here is caught by get_many and becomes a cache MISS -- recompute, not quietly-wrong. ANALYSIS_VERSION already separates the generations; this is the second lock on the same door.
claims.why: The code uses subscript access (doc['key']) for all fields in FileAnalysis constructor. The comment about KeyError being caught externally is uncheckable but the claim about subscript usage is verified.

claims.text: Subscript, like every field above: a row from before the type layer has no such key, and a .get(PyTypeFacts()) default would decode it into a plausible analysis claiming the file has NO types -- which is indistinguishable from a file that genuinely has none.
claims.why: The code uses doc['type_facts'] subscript, not .get. The reasoning about default being indistinguishable is a comment, not a claim about this code.

claims.text: Keep only the most recently used cache DBs.
claims.why: The function body is truncated; only the docstring and beginning of try block are present. The actual eviction logic is not in this chunk.

claims.text: Each DB is named by a hash of the repo root, so a root that disappears leaves an orphan nothing will ever reopen -- and the test suite indexes throwaway temp repos, which would otherwise drop a new orphan in the user's profile on every run. The root is unrecoverable from the hash, so bound the directory by recency instead.
claims.why: These are explanatory comments about the design; no code in this chunk implements or verifies these claims.

observations.what: _enc_facts and _dec_facts convert types/fields/signatures/aliases to/from lists; consumers expecting mutable lists may receive tuples.
_encode uses zlib.compress with level 1 (fast but less compression).
_decode converts py_imports and raw_imports from lists to tuples; shape-compatible but type change.
_evict_old_caches docstring claims recency-based eviction but implementation is not visible.
